project.description: The name of the library project to initialize with NestJS.

projects.description: The list of library projects to initialize with NestJS.

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite existing files during initialization.

skipFormat.description: Whether to skip formatting files with Prettier after initialization.

skipProjects.description: Whether to skip executing project-specific initialization logic.

fixDependencies.description: Whether to add the 'fix-dependencies' target to the library project.

indexExport.description: Whether to add the 'index-export' target to the library project.
